title: Guard Off the Seventh
setup: Your queen and bishop aim at g7, but Black's queen on c7 covers that square along the seventh rank.
hint: Two of yours attack g7 and two of theirs defend it. Which defender can be handed a job elsewhere?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rxd8+}} forces {{Qxd8}}, and from d8 the queen no longer sees g7. {{Qxg7#}} mates, the bishop on b2 holding the queen in place. Count the defenders of a mating square, then remove one. Mating squares are guarded by pieces, and pieces can be given other work.
